subject: planner: fix the issue accessing unnecessary table side caused by column pruning (#54609)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: removes LogicalLimit PruneColumns early-return on empty parent-used-cols so pruning reaches children (fixing cases like Issue54213 where LIMIT blocked pruning and forced unnecessary table access), and guards LogicalSchemaProducer.InlineProjection from pruning to empty on empty parent-used-cols; added an integration test asserting IndexReader plan. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/txn/privilege issues found; later upstream history shows further related pruning hardening/refactors but nothing indicating an unfixed High/Blocker from this change.
